summary.text: Samuel Lusk is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He won the May 12, 2026 Republican primary over Thurman Dickerson, 793 votes to 546, and faces Democrat Brianna Pearcy and independent Ronnie Oakley in an open-seat race.
